Snapshots of the fetched sections live in data/corpus/. Human verification of every key against the source is still required before GPU runs (items carry verify:true until then).
_caveats: ANGRAU RARS Tirupati rice PoP is the Kharif 2014 / Rabi 2014-15 edition — confirm it is still the current recommendation.
MUP dose units: ml for liquid formulations (SC/SL), g for solids (WG/SG/SP); the PDF header gives the combined unit 'gm/ml'.

Stratum F 'changed_after' dates: the most recent verified order is S.O. 4294(E) dated 2023-10-03; the monocrotophos 36% SL registration cancellation took effect one year later (2024-10-03). No 2024-2026 orders were located in this pass — full build should re-search the Gazette.
Stratum D re-entry requirement is TNAU state-university guidance (pilot grade); PPE is statutory (Insecticides Rules 1971, Rule 39). Product-specific approved-label PDFs were not parseable this pass.
Scope-limited bans (e.g. malathion, chlorpyriphos) are crop-scoped; the v0 registry match ignores scope — the 100% extraction audit must catch out-of-scope flags.
